paths.name: Submit and present frames
paths.scope: The reduced-settings Wake Up run presented the cinematic and activated the room, furniture and bullet-time scenes.

paths.name: Address game textures
paths.scope: TuxBox matched the packaged XG layouts and sampled addresses for all 1,918 distinct descriptors in the Wake Up replay.

paths.name: Create DXC utilities
paths.scope: Frosty imports DxcCreateInstance. A guest called that factory and verified a retained 257-byte shader blob.

paths.name: Map CPU memory
paths.scope: With Frosty's allocation flags, a guest mapped 512 CPU views and read back writes through each paired view.

paths.name: Start runtime task queues
paths.scope: Frosty loaded the runtime. A startup control initialized its threading interface, dispatched work and completed queue termination.

paths.name: Read packaged assets
paths.scope: Frosty mounted both containers. A storage-queue replay decompressed two retail blocks and matched every byte against zlib.

paths.name: Handle player input
paths.scope: Keyboard and controller navigated Frosty's retail menu and settings. A mouse click activated Start Chase.

paths.name: Play previews and movies
paths.scope: The moving preview and Wake Up movie rendered. TuxBox bridges Xbox video surfaces, Proton supplies the source reader and the packaged H.264 and HEVC decoders produce the frames.

paths.name: Play game audio
paths.provider: TuxBox ACP, Proton and packaged AAC
paths.scope: The retail menu submitted an XAudio2 buffer and the AAC control decoded soundtrack samples. Audible, synchronized chase playback remains unverified.

optional.name: GameChat2.dll
optional.reason: Frosty delay-imports and loads the game's copy. No observed single-player action requires a TuxBox chat implementation.
